name: Ralph Lauren
description: Ralph Lauren designs and markets luxury and premium apparel, handbags, footwear, fragrance and home goods, and sells them through its own stores and websites (68 percent of FY2026 sales), department-store and specialty wholesale accounts (30 percent) and licensing partners (2 percent). It owns no factories. FY2026 revenue was $8.1 billion (+14.6%) with a 69.9 percent gross margin and 14.5 percent operating margin, with Asia (+23%) and Europe (+17%) growing fastest. Licensing is tiny in sales but almost pure profit (86.9 percent segment margin).

sub.name: Fashion, footwear, beauty and leisure brands

gics.note: Wikipedia list gives only sector and sub-industry; industry group and industry were not in a source read, so left null.

employees.note: About 15,600 full-time and 8,000 part-time; 9,400 in the US (FY2026 10-K)

businessLines.name: North America
businessLines.how: Full-price and outlet retail through own stores and sites (about two thirds of the segment) plus shipments to department stores; revenue is product price, margin is the brand premium.
businessLines.description: Ralph Lauren stores, outlets, digital and wholesale (department stores, specialty) in the US and Canada

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income, before corporate expenses

businessLines.name: Europe
businessLines.how: About half own retail and half wholesale to premium retailers; highest-margin region apart from licensing.
businessLines.description: Own stores, concessions, digital and wholesale across Europe and the Middle East

businessLines.name: Asia
businessLines.how: Almost all company-run retail (96 percent of segment sales), including 615 concession shops where RL staffs counters inside department stores and keeps the retail margin.
businessLines.description: Own stores, concession shops (mostly in department stores) and digital in China, Japan, Korea and elsewhere

businessLines.name: Other non-reportable (licensing)
businessLines.how: Partners that own the operations and most product development cost pay royalties on their sales of RL-branded goods; almost no cost to RL.
businessLines.description: Royalties from Ralph Lauren and Chaps-branded products made and sold by licensing partners

brands.name: Ralph Lauren Collection / Purple Label / Double RL
brands.note: Luxury tiers; shares by brand not disclosed

brands.name: Polo Ralph Lauren, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Sport, RLX, Polo Ralph Lauren Children
brands.note: Core and premium lines; shares not disclosed

brands.note: Licensed (royalty revenue inside the 142.5 licensing line)
